scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Populations, gene pools and genetic variation
lessons.learningGoal: Define a gene pool and distinguish change in a population from change within an individual.

lessons.title: Allele frequencies and genotype frequencies
lessons.learningGoal: Calculate genotype and allele frequencies directly from diploid genotype counts.

lessons.title: The Hardy–Weinberg model and its assumptions
lessons.learningGoal: Explain the model’s conditions and distinguish allele totals from expected genotype frequencies.

lessons.title: Calculating expected genotype frequencies
lessons.learningGoal: Solve Hardy–Weinberg problems with explicit assumptions, separate quantities and reasonableness checks.

lessons.title: Using population data to test a prediction
lessons.learningGoal: Compare observed and expected genotype counts without claiming that one mismatch identifies its cause.

lessons.title: Natural selection and non-random mating
lessons.learningGoal: Explain selection through differential reproductive success and distinguish it from mate-pairing effects.

lessons.title: Genetic drift, bottlenecks and founder effects
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish chance sampling from selection and compare bottleneck and founder cases.

lessons.title: Gene flow and mutation
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish movement of existing alleles from the creation of new sequence variants.

lessons.title: Genetic diversity and conservation evidence
lessons.learningGoal: Use population-genetic mechanisms to evaluate conservation evidence without assuming a universal outcome.
